Question_or_Title: Trigger
Rule_or_Notes: Only the FIRST answer button (0 points) can trigger a paragraph: Disagree in section 1, Weak in sections 2-4. Unsure, Improving, Agree and Strong never trigger one.

Question_or_Title: When it runs
Rule_or_Notes: Focus items are collected inside calculateScore(), which runs at each section boundary (after Q7, Q14, Q21, Q28). The list persists and accumulates between runs.

Question_or_Title: Order
Rule_or_Notes: Chairs are processed in order 1, 2, 3, 4; within a chair, by question number ascending. The list is displayed in the order collected.

Question_or_Title: Chair 1 rule
Rule_or_Notes: A Chair 1 paragraph is added only if the list is currently empty. All 7 Chair 1 questions share one paragraph, so Chair 1 contributes at most 1 item, and it is always first.

Question_or_Title: Chairs 2-4 rule
Rule_or_Notes: A paragraph is added only while the list has fewer than 4 items.

Question_or_Title: Cap
Rule_or_Notes: The list never exceeds 4 items in total (including any Chair 1 item).

Question_or_Title: De-duplication
Rule_or_Notes: A paragraph already in the list is not added again. This only matters for the shared Chair 1 paragraph; all other paragraphs are unique per question.

Question_or_Title: Failing section is included
Rule_or_Notes: A chair's questions are fully processed (focus items collected) before its pass/fail threshold is checked. The failing section's weak answers therefore count, even when placement points to an earlier chair (e.g., failing section 3 places the user in Chair 2 but section 3 paragraphs can appear).

Question_or_Title: Unreached sections
Rule_or_Notes: Sections never answered (the quiz ended earlier) contribute no paragraphs.

Question_or_Title: Max zeros in a passed section
Rule_or_Notes: Passed section 1 (score >= 18) can contain at most 1 Disagree. Passed sections 2-4 (score >= 14) can contain at most 2 Weak.

Question_or_Title: Failing section guarantees a zero
Rule_or_Notes: Failing section 2, 3 or 4 (score < 14) requires at least one Weak answer (seven non-zero answers total at least 14), so at least one paragraph from that section is collected.

Question_or_Title: Crowd-out
Rule_or_Notes: Before section 4, up to 5 items are possible (1 + 2 + 2) against a cap of 4. Section 4 paragraphs can therefore be fully crowded out; likewise section 3 paragraphs can be partly crowded out by sections 1-2.

Question_or_Title: Failing section 1 does not guarantee a paragraph
Rule_or_Notes: Section 1 can be failed with no Disagree (e.g., all Unsure = 14). In that case no paragraph is collected and the list is empty.

Question_or_Title: Empty list
Rule_or_Notes: If no first-button answers were given in the evaluated sections, the list is empty and the 'Where should I focus?' header and bullets are not shown.

Question_or_Title: Display
Rule_or_Notes: Bullets appear under the heading 'Where should I focus?'. Immediately after completion the live list is shown; when viewing a completed assessment later, the list saved with the results is shown.

Question_or_Title: Stale items
Rule_or_Notes: The list is cleared only on a full restart/retake. If the user goes back across a section boundary and changes answers, previously collected paragraphs remain in the list.

Question_or_Title: Fail section 1
Rule_or_Notes: S1 < 18 -> Chair 1; fraction = 1 + S1/21 (about 1.00-1.81). Quiz ends after 7 questions.

Question_or_Title: Fail section 2
Rule_or_Notes: S1 >= 18 and S2 < 14 -> Chair 2; fraction = 2 + S2/21 (about 2.00-2.62). Quiz ends after 14 questions.

Question_or_Title: Fail section 3
Rule_or_Notes: S2 >= 14 and S3 < 14 -> Chair 2 (not 3); fraction = 2 + S2/21 (about 2.67-2.95; 2.9 if S2 = 21). Quiz ends after 21 questions.

Question_or_Title: Fail section 4
Rule_or_Notes: S3 >= 14 and S4 < 14 -> Chair 3; fraction = 3 + S3/21 (about 3.67-3.95; 3.9 if S3 = 21). Quiz ends after 28 questions.

Question_or_Title: Pass section 4
Rule_or_Notes: S4 >= 14 -> Chair 4; fraction = 4 + S4/21 (about 4.67-4.95; capped at 4.9 if S4 = 21). Quiz ends after 28 questions.

Question_or_Title: Points per answer
Rule_or_Notes: 1st button (Disagree/Weak) = 0; 2nd button (Unsure/Improving) = 2; 3rd button (Agree/Strong) = 3. Section score = sum of 7 answers (0-21).

Question_or_Title: All Unsure in section 1
Rule_or_Notes: Section 1 all Unsure = 14 (< 18) -> Chair 1, fraction 1.67. No Disagree answers, so the focus list is empty.

Question_or_Title: S1: 6 Agree + 1 Disagree (18). S2: Q9 and Q12 Weak, rest Strong (15). S3: Q15, Q16, Q17 Weak, rest Strong (12).
Rule_or_Notes: Passes S1 and S2, fails S3 -> Chair 2, fraction 2 + 15/21 = 2.71. Focus list = Chair 1 paragraph, FR-09, FR-12, FR-15 (cap of 4 reached; FR-16 and FR-17 not added).

Question_or_Title: S1: 6 Agree + 1 Disagree (18). S2: Q8, Q9 Weak, rest Strong (15). S3: Q15, Q16 Weak, rest Strong (15). S4: Q22 Weak, rest Improving (12).
Rule_or_Notes: Fails S4 -> Chair 3, fraction 3 + 15/21 = 3.71. Focus list = Chair 1 paragraph, FR-08, FR-09, FR-15 (cap reached; FR-16 and FR-22 crowded out).

Question_or_Title: S1 all Agree (21). S2, S3, S4 all Improving (14 each).
Rule_or_Notes: Passes everything -> Chair 4, fraction 4 + 14/21 = 4.67. No first-button answers, so the focus list is empty.
